packageRules.description: welsh-lib's adapters/ts-locale-pair.ts parses with the classic compiler API (ts.createSourceFile, ts.isVariableStatement, ts.SyntaxKind), which TypeScript 7 removes.
The runtime image hmctsprod.azurecr.io/base/node has no tag above 24, so Node and its types stay on 24.
The integration-test container in Jenkinsfile_CNP and the AAT flexible server are on Postgres 16, and the hand-written migrations must match the deploy target.
